title: Raw over comparison component
statement: For a commutative ring Λ, schemes W and S, k:W→S, a sheaf G on W_et,  an integer q, an arrow f:A→B of objects over W, an etale S-object U, and a raw class z on B, the explicitly constructed raw pullback r_f(z) satisfies e_A(r_f(z)) = t_f(e_B(z)), where e_A and e_B are the fixed raw comparison maps to the associated higher direct image sections and t_f is the canonical higher-image transition. This is the evaluated section equality used by the naturality theorem.

source.place: Tags 03Q8 and 09Z1, canonical comparison maps; explicit derived-Hom formulation

proof.text: Use the shared actual complexes (B^*G)[0] and (A^*G)[0] and the shared fixed coefficient composite as the parameters of higherDirectImageRawTransition_toHom. The raw over pullback is definitionally this triangle pullback. Rewrite higherDirectImageOverMap with higherDirectImageOverMap_coefficient at the level of its action on sections.

Apply higherDirectImageOverMap_coefficient to identify the degree-q homology of the derived transition followed by the combined coefficient map with the canonical higherDirectImageOverMap. This is exactly the morphism on the right of the specialized raw triangle comparison.

Expand the fixed raw-to-sheaf comparison as ToHom followed by freeSheafSections. Apply section evaluation to the specialized ToHom equality. The private proved evaluation_postcomp is the component at U of the existing freeSheafSections_naturality, and identifies evaluation after postcomposition with the transition applied after evaluation.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03Q8 and 09Z1; P3 specializes the existing pre-evaluation triangle comparison, identifies the transition by functoriality, and uses free-sheaf evaluation naturality.

lean.statement:
theorem higherDirectImageRawOverPullback_comparison
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℤ)
    {A B : Over W} (f : A ⟶ B) (U : S.Etale)
    (z : (higherDirectImageRawOverPresheaf Λ k G q B).obj (op U)) :
    (higherDirectImageRawOverComparison Λ k G q A).app (op U)
        (higherDirectImageRawOverPullback Λ k G q f U z) =
    ((higherDirectImageOverMap Λ k G q f).hom.app (op U))
      ((higherDirectImageRawOverComparison Λ k G q B).app (op U) z)
